- [Brand API by domain](https://docs.brandfetch.com/reference/brand-api-domain.md): Get brand data using a domain name
- [Brand API by ISIN](https://docs.brandfetch.com/reference/brand-api-isin.md): Get brand data using an ISIN code
- [Brand API by ticker](https://docs.brandfetch.com/reference/brand-api-ticker.md): Get brand data using a Stock or ETF ticker
- [Brand Context API](https://docs.brandfetch.com/reference/brand-context-api.md): Get a structured, narrative-rich brand context for a domain — including identity, positioning, voice, and visual style.
- [Brand Search API](https://docs.brandfetch.com/reference/brand-search-api.md): Search for brands by name, login to get a clientId
- [Transaction API](https://docs.brandfetch.com/reference/transaction-api.md): Turn payment transactions into merchant data
